semiconductor_relevance: High — Indnix Technology Limited is deeply involved in semiconductor manufacturing and assembly, with a focus on high-volume production and specialized fabrication processes.
summary: Indnix Technology Limited operates a vertically integrated semiconductor manufacturing facility in Eastern India, with a focus on high-volume production of logic, analog, and power management ICs. They also specialize in compound semiconductor and MEMS fabrication, offering assembly and test services for automotive and IoT applications.

regional_presence.India: Indnix operates a 'Giga-Fab' in Eastern India with a target capacity of 70,000 wafer starts per month.
